title: Adding up odd numbers
question: If I add up the first n odd numbers (1+3+5+...), do I always get a perfect square?
plain_restatement: For every whole number n, 1 + 3 + 5 + ... (the first n odd numbers) equals n times n.

variables.name: n
variables.meaning: how many odd numbers are added

assumptions: n counts from 0 (adding no numbers gives 0)
fidelity_note: Checks every n up to 100,000, not every whole number there is.
